counter_run.tool: perf instructions:u plus separate heaptrack process

protocol.aggregation: per side: arithmetic mean in ns of its two unrounded Criterion mean.point_estimate values; no weighting by iteration count; round only the final side mean to integer ps if subsequently producing approved policy rows
protocol.quantiles: per side: pool its 200 Criterion sample means (time_ns/iterations); nearest-rank ceil(p*N)-1 for p50/p95/p99; these are not individual-operation tail latencies
protocol.counter_scope: whole filtered Criterion process, including startup, all suite fixture setup, warmup/calibration and measured work; separate perf and heaptrack invocations; not per-operation counters; profiler timings never enter latency aggregation
protocol.failure_policy: all four complete runs are required; any failed/contaminated run invalidates the session; preserve every attempt and predeclare an entirely new session before any rerun; no best-run selection or threshold edits
protocol.dependency_lock_policy: Candidate Cargo.lock must equal baseline byte-for-byte after removing exactly one reference workspace package 0.1.0 stanza with dependencies proptest, vb_core, vb_expr, vb_storage, and exactly one quoted reference dependency line within the velvet-ballistics-workspace-tests 0.1.0 dependency list. No reference edge elsewhere or any other byte difference is permitted. Both actual lockfiles must match frozen source receipts; all existing package versions, features and checksums remain exact. No new third-party dependency is allowed. Protocol metadata changes the build freeze: fresh baseline and candidate builds using this R5 recipe are required; no compatibility attestation or prior-build reuse.
